Derelict 4-Bedroom Bungalow on Approx. 0.86 Acres – Exceptional Redevelopment Opportunity

Hutchinson Auctioneers are delighted to present this substantial detached bungalow on approximately 0.86 acres, offering an outstanding opportunity for developers, investors, builders and those seeking a renovation project in a highly sought-after location on the outskirts of Waterford City.

Constructed circa 1975, this detached residence extends to a spacious four-bedroom layout and is complemented by a **detached garage** and generous surrounding grounds. While the property requires complete refurbishment and modernisation, it offers exceptional potential to create a superb family home or explore redevelopment opportunities, subject to the necessary planning permission.

Ideally positioned on the Lacken Road in Kilbarry, the property enjoys the perfect balance of a peaceful setting while remaining within easy reach of Waterford City Centre. It is conveniently located close to schools, shops, SETU, public transport and all local amenities.

The property has been **vacant for more than two years**, making it of particular interest to purchasers wishing to avail of available refurbishment incentives, subject to meeting the relevant scheme criteria and approval.

Accommodation

* Entrance Porch
* Entrance Hall
* Sitting Room
* Kitchen/Dining Room
* Utility Room
* Four Bedrooms
* Bathroom
* Separate WC

Features

* Detached bungalow on approximately 0.86 acres
* Detached garage
* Excellent renovation and investment opportunity
* Ideal for developers, builders and investors
* Superb potential to extend or redevelop (subject to planning permission)
* Established and convenient residential location
* Vacant for over two years
* Freehold title
* Mains electricity
* Mains water supply
* Septic tank
* Oil-fired central heating
* BER: G

Properties offering this level of potential on such a generous site in this location rarely come to the market. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the opportunity on offer.

For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact Hutchinson Auctioneers.
Located between Easter Island Garden Centre & Murco Kitchen Equipment Suppliers
